def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    dividers = image_patch.find("divider")
    
    if not cars or not dividers:
        return []
    
    central_divider = min(dividers, key=lambda d: abs(d.horizontal_center))
    left_cars = [car for car in cars if car.left < central_divider.left]
    right_cars = [car for car in cars if car.right > central_divider.right]
    
    return left_cars + right_cars
